referral.connect_ethereum_wallet: Please connect your Ethereum wallet to generate a referral code
referral.faq_how_works: How does the Bitty referral program work?
referral.faq_how_works_answer: When someone uses your referral code to supply, borrow, staking in our platform, you earn a 5% of their incentives, the people been invited can get 5% more incentive too.
referral.faq_how_share: How do I share my referral code?
referral.faq_how_share_answer: You can copy your unique referral code or link from the referral section above. Share it with your friends, or on social media to get incentive.
referral.faq_when_check: When can I check my rewards?
referral.faq_when_check_answer: Our rewards page is under construction, you can check your rewards in the rewards page after it's released.
referral.faq_how_long: How long does the referral last?
referral.faq_how_long_answer: as long as address been referred by you is using the platform in the rewards activity time.
referral.faq_limit: Is there a limit to the referral rewards?
referral.faq_limit_answer: No, there is no limit to the referral reward, it's working for both Bitcoin and Ethereum.
referral.faq_self_referral: Can I use my own referral code?
referral.faq_self_referral_answer: No, you cannot use your own referral code. Referral codes are designed to reward you for bringing new users to the platform, not for self-referrals.
referral.no_referrals_description: Start sharing your referral link to earn rewards

referral.step_2: They sign up using your code
referral.step_3: Earn rewards when they use the platform
